_comment: Copy to DIRECTOR/director_work.json. schema_version: the config format; tools refuse a version they do not know. window: 100000-1000000. plugins_off: only user-installed plugins, as name@marketplace, after the PO ticked them. backup_dir: null = inside the repo's .git folder. skip_worktrees: path substrings to leave alone. hooks: true adds the hook_guard.py PreToolUse hook. protect_director (optional): the DIRECTOR folder; the hook then also blocks Write / Edit on its orders/ and DIRECTOR_LOG.md (implies hooks). director_worktree (optional): the Director's own worktree, which keeps the plain hook.trace_id_pattern (optional): regex for the requirement or decision IDs that orders list in TRACES_TO; trace_report.py flags IDs that do not fit. Use the project's own IDs. mode (optional): general or beginner, picked right after the starting prompt (docs/12); tools do not read it. po_pending_files / po_item_pattern / po_open_pattern (optional): where metrics_report.py counts PO entries; the defaults read PO_PENDING.md entries `ID: OD-..` / `ID: ACT-..` with `STATUS: open`. resume (2.2.2, optional): RESUME_STATE size limits (max_bytes, max_line_bytes; read by gate_check --resume, setup_check and memory_size_check --kind resume) and what resume_archive.py never moves (the newest keep_recent sections and Before: chain entries, by count, never by age; sections whose heading holds a protect_headings word). base_ref (2.2.2, optional): gate_check --order fetches and compares the order's BASE_REF commit with its remote branch; missing or behind is a WARN note, strict: true (or --strict-base) fails; fetch: false compares with the local copy. release (2.2.2, optional): release.py settings; {version} is filled in; gh_repo null = read from the remote URL. verdict_self_check (2.3.0, optional): what gate_check --verdict does when a PASS-type verdict has no self-checked `- `<command>` exit=<n> at=<HH:MM>` line: "warn" (default in 2.3.x: a WARN note, exit code unchanged) or "fail" (the verdict fails); the default may become "fail" in 3.0. strength (3.0.0, optional): light | standard | strict, which safety gates gate_check --order / --match runs on Standard / Strict orders (tools/safety_gate.py); default standard = tests_first only (the order carries TESTS_LOCKED); strict = all. safety (3.0.0, optional): switches that tighten the strength (tests_first, plan_gate, spec_review_for_standard: true / false; stop_after_rounds: a whole number, 0 = not checked; prefer_auto). Anything looser than the strength, or strength light, fails Standard / Strict orders until a PO_PENDING entry naming it is answered: a worker may not turn a gate off. order_limits / protected_tests (3.0.0 B4, optional, read by scope_check.py): size limits for Standard / Strict orders (max_files_per_order, max_lines_per_order, max_test_lines_per_order; 0 = off) and globs of test files that may only grow; not set = not checked, at every strength. An order can set its own with ORDER_LIMITS = files=<n> lines=<n> test_lines=<n>.
